comment: How the director turns a mode change into a transition: duration, hazard reduction on both sides, and scene instructions. Effects are chosen sparingly -- never all at once.

duration.comment: 2-4 seconds, i.e. 4-8 beats at typical tempos. Scaled by the energy jump across the boundary.

tail.comment: Last bars of the outgoing section: swap to RECOVERY-family / lowest-difficulty patterns at reduced intensity so the player gets a breather.

head.comment: First bars of the incoming section: TEACH patterns at reduced intensity so new controls are introduced gently.

scene.comment: Scene-transition instructions carried in the blueprint and (as an editor extension) into level.json sections[].scene. The runtime currently ignores them; a future scene hook can consume them.

effects.comment: Background/palette shift toward the incoming mode's palette.
A push-in that settles as the new mode starts.
Full-screen wipe -- the runtime's existing placeholder wipe, parameterised.
One-shot light flash on the downbeat of the new section.
Camera pan toward the incoming mode's focal point.

kinds.comment: Transition ids follow the runtime convention FROM_TO. The runtime shows the id during its 1-beat wipe; the musical work happens in the tail/head bars.

playerPrep.comment: Per-mode prep notes surfaced in the blueprint for future HUD hooks.
playerPrep.RADIAL: Arrows or WASD, diagonals are two keys
